## Pull request overview

This PR attempts to fix a runtime error where the documentation's `InteractiveDemo` component throws "Unknown component type: dashboard" when rendering dashboard examples from `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx`.

**Changes:**
- Added `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` import to the plugin loading array in `InteractiveDemo.tsx`

The import statement for `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` will fail at runtime because this package is not listed as a dependency in `apps/site/package.json`.

All other plugins imported in this file (aggrid, editor, charts, kanban, markdown, timeline, calendar, gantt, map, chatbot, form, grid, view) are correctly listed in the dependencies. The dashboard plugin must be added to `apps/site/package.json` alongside the import to resolve this issue.

Add the following to the dependencies section of `apps/site/package.json`:
"@object-ui/plugin-dashboard": "workspace:*"
